name: Kiritaka Muse

aliases.name: The Man Whose Heart Was Stolen by the Songstress

description: Kiritaka Muse is a trade representative of the Watergate City of Priestella, the owner of the Muse Company, and a member of the Council of Ten. Madly infatuated with the Songstress Liliana Masquerade, he controls the city's magic stone trade and played a key supporting role during the Witch Cult's assault on Priestella in Arc 5.
